Platinum SCM controller diagram 11 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies at www.nlr.gov/publications. 3 Hardware Characterization A critical step in developing both SCM control capabilities and sitewide emulation abilities is testing to characterize hardware performance. This will identify the hardware limitations in response to SCM controls and help develop a physics model to emulate systemwide operations. This effort characterized lower-power DC fast chargers in the 20- to 30-kW range (see Table 1) to augment the 350-kW DC fast chargers characterized as part of the NextGen Profiles project that were used in this effort [12]. The following hardware testing results informed both the development of SCM objective functions and transfer functions for control hardware-in-the-loop (CHIL) emulations of hundreds of EV chargers and DER assets.
